correctness.rationale: Use V_N(s)=Ns(1−s)+2Σ_{i<j}K_s(X_i,X_j) where K_s is the autocorrelation of centered arc indicators. At s=1/2, K=1/4−min(|x−y|,1−|x−y|), Fourier Khat(k)=sin²(πk/2)/(π²k²); the second harmonic vanishes. The two f have identical Fourier power (coefficients ±1 and ±2 of modulus ε/2) but ratio fhat(2)/fhat(1)² is respectively real versus pure imaginary, so they are not rotations/reflections. Thus pair difference law and full V2(·) curve law agree; EV_N(s) for any N agrees. For N≥3 shared-vertex edge-pair covariance gives Var V_N=4[C(N,2)A+N(N−1)(N−2)B]. Conditional potential for either density is Φ(x)=ε cos(2πx)/π², identical mean μ=ε²/(2π²), and B+−B_perp=ε³/(4π⁴) by cos² identity. Independently evaluated the 1D conditional overlap integral with adaptive quadrature at ε=0.1,0.31,0.49; ratios of measured vs claimed exact gap were 1.000000000000001,1.0000000000000004,1.0000000000000004. This is a finite numerical corroboration of the exact all-N analytic derivation. Positive densities for ε<1/2, N1 deterministic, no claim of general density identifiability.
